skills.name: Twinblade Wolf II
lines: Consumes one Wolfheart to perform the following moves in succession at no MP cost: Wolf's Awakening -> Fa Jin Slash (Non type slash attack on a single enemy) -> Crusher Blow (Wind type slash attack on all enemies x5) -> Sky Mirror -> Wicked Wolf Sweep (Wind type slash attack on all enemies x2)
* User performs skills even if not learned
* Replaces the basic attack when user possesses Wolfheart stack.
* Because the skills performed by using Twinblade Wolf II are not basic attack replacements themselves, the Enhance Normal Attack Grasta will not increase their damage.

* When used during Stellar Burst: Activate Twinblade Wolf II
** Does not consume Wolfheart Stack
